graph.name: Deloitte Converge Banking Cloud Architecture
graph.categories: Financial Services, Compute, Analytics & Data Lakes, Security & Identity
graph.notes: Converge Banking by Deloitte is a cloud platform for banking and financial services. It utilizes Amazon EKS for running microservices, Amazon MSK for streaming mutation events, Amazon Redshift for downstream analytics, Amazon API Gateway as the front door, and Amazon Cognito combined with AWS Lambda for compliant customer identity and step-up security.

nodes.name: Amazon API Gateway
nodes.notes: Serves as the front door access point, integrating with Cognito for token validation and developer portal capabilities.

nodes.name: Amazon Cognito
nodes.notes: Provides customer identity and access management (CIAM), meeting global banking security and regulatory requirements.

nodes.name: AWS Lambda
nodes.notes: Executes custom extensions during token generation for step-up security and fraud system integration.

nodes.name: Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS)
nodes.notes: Core compute engine running containerized banking microservices that elastically scales and emits state changes.

nodes.name: Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK)
nodes.notes: Managed event streaming backbone capturing all cluster mutation events and supporting real-time subscriptions.

nodes.name: Amazon Redshift
nodes.notes: Receives real-time streaming data from Amazon MSK to feed the downstream data lake and analytics platform.

edges.notes: Amazon Cognito triggers AWS Lambda during token generation for custom step-up security and fraud management.
Amazon API Gateway performs token validation via integration with Amazon Cognito.
State mutations in Amazon EKS emit events directly to Amazon MSK.
EKS microservices subscribe back to Amazon MSK streams in real time for event-driven updates.
Amazon MSK streams event payloads to Amazon Redshift to populate the downstream data lake.
